November 20 draft: coded benchmark change register

Comparison of the November 20, 2026 Ref-20438 rule text with FDOE’s October 26, 2026 grade-band PDFs. This register covers coded leaf benchmarks and benchmark-linked examples, clarifications, and tasks. It lists changed records and unaligned latest records without copying the source text.

1,573October 26 records
1,625November 20 records
652changed or unmatched rows
Source and rights note: This register does not reproduce the standards text. Use the official November 20 reference document (Ref-20438) and the FDOE review page for the source versions. Public copies of the full text are not hosted here while redistribution terms remain unverified.

Download the row-level CSV · Read findings and method · Open the November 20 source · Open FDOE’s October 26 review materials

How to read this table

All coded leaf-benchmark records with wording or code changes, plus latest records without a close prior text match.

“Added” and “removed” are normalized word-token counts from the local comparison; they are not measures of educational scope or information. Candidate reference coverage means the changed wording had exact five-word phrase overlap with a local source file. It does not establish that the draft authors used that source, or settle conceptual coverage. “No strong overlap” is not evidence that no reference covers the topic. Viewpoint notes identify explicit topical signals; they do not infer motive.

Three benchmark identifiers occur twice in the November DOCX with different texts. They remain separate rows; cite the official document’s text as well as the code.
